notes: Variant is a kneeling high-pulley cable crunch using a rope or handle. Rectus abdominis is primary because loaded and common crunch EMG support strong rectus activity during trunk flexion. External and internal oblique are secondary abdominal-wall contributors. Rectus femoris and iliopsoas were not listed because the target technique keeps hip motion limited; if the movement is performed as a hip hinge, that is a form error or a separate variant.
